title: Ballot case package
description: Input of a ballot task governance.ballot.v1 (GOV-7): the case package that the core builds from the tenant's records for one voter. For each seat in L it carries symmetric figures only: recommendations, vetoes, how many were confirmed and refuted, the calibration (COM-11) and the term. The order of seats differs for each voter by the seed of the case opening and matches the order of the voter's enum. Seats are named only by labels that the core draws for each voter from the same seed (s1, s2, ...), never by the seat id; the core maps the chosen label back to the seat (GOV-7). There is no free text, no author identity and no other ballot (GOV-29).

voter_bot.description: The voting identity: the package is built for it.

seats.description: The seats of L that are in this voter's enum, in the voter's order.

label.description: Label of the seat for this voter only, drawn from the seed of the case opening; the same value is in the voter's enum. The seat id never reaches the model (GOV-7).

recommended.description: How many times the holder recommended.

vetoed.description: How many times the holder vetoed.

confirmed.description: How many of these were confirmed (GOV-7).

refuted.description: How many of these were refuted (GOV-7).

calibration.description: Calibration of the seat's lens executor (COM-11).

tenure_days.description: Continuous term of the holder in the commission, in days.

reviews.description: Number of the holder's reviews in the window.

candidate.description: The candidate's track record and its executed proposal in code words.

proposal_kind.description: Change kind of the proposal that gave the trigger.

track_record.description: Trial outcomes of the candidate's executed proposals.
